applicabilityConditions: Edition identity must be resolved and valid.
Reporting interval must be computed from edition date (not execution time).
All selected candidates must have temporal eligibility classification.
requiredGates.name: T — Temporal Integrity
requiredGates.purpose: Verify correct edition identity, timezone-aware reporting interval, valid first-disclosure evidence, correct novelty classification, and appropriate historical context.
validationRules: Reporting interval is [previous day 05:00, edition day 05:00) Europe/Amsterdam.
DST-aware interval is correct (23h spring forward, 24h normal, 25h fall back).
All selected candidates have valid temporal eligibility status.
No candidate has unresolved temporal eligibility.
Novelty classification is from the authoritative upstream classifier.
First-disclosure timestamps are traceable to original sources.

applicabilityConditions: All three discovery rings must have been executed.
Mandatory developer-tool and coding-agent monitoring must have been executed.
Independent omission review must have been completed.
requiredGates.name: D — Discovery Coverage
requiredGates.purpose: Verify that the established source-discovery requirements were actually executed across all three rings, mandatory developer-tool monitoring was completed, source statuses are accurately reported, and independent omission review was completed.
validationRules: Ring 1 official first-party sources were monitored.
Ring 2 independent research sources were monitored.
Ring 3 expert and community sources were monitored.
Mandatory developer-tool and coding-agent monitoring was executed.
Inaccessible sources are explicitly reported as INACCESSIBLE.
Sources never checked are reported as NOT_CHECKED.
Omission review has no unresolved critical omissions.

applicabilityConditions: Canonical fact dossier must be complete and valid.
All material claims must have verification records.
requiredGates.name: E — Evidence Integrity
requiredGates.purpose: Verify that the final publication contains no material factual assertions unsupported by the canonical fact dossier, with original source provenance, research methodology, uncertainty and limitations, and absence of fabricated claims.
validationRules: All material claims have verified evidence.
Evidence classifications are accurate (VERIFIED_FACT, VENDOR_CLAIM, RESEARCH_FINDING, etc.).
Product versions and release maturity are correctly stated.
Strategic and economic interpretations are distinguished from facts.
No fabricated or contradictory factual claims exist.

applicabilityConditions: Historical regression must have been executed.
Historical records must be accessible for comparison.
requiredGates.name: H — Historical Regression
requiredGates.purpose: Verify that the historical comparison was completed according to its existing seven-calendar-day contract, with historical records actually consulted, previously reported developments identified, genuine substantive changes classified, and explicit catch-up handling.
validationRules: Genuine substantive changes are classified as SUBSTANTIVE_UPDATE.
Duplicated reporting is classified as REPEATED_REPORTING.
Newly disclosed older events are classified as NEWLY_DISCLOSED_HISTORICAL.

applicabilityConditions: Editorial selection manifest must be valid.
Canonical fact dossier must be complete.
Discovery evidence must be complete.
requiredGates.name: X — Editorial Integrity
requiredGates.purpose: Validate the editorial selection manifest against the canonical fact dossier and completed discovery evidence, ensuring valid story identifiers, verified eligibility, explicit editorial selection, required ordering, coverage of materially significant developments, no unsupported additional stories, no unexplained omission of selected stories, vendor-neutral editorial treatment, and appropriate scientific, economic and strategic research coverage.
validationRules: Story identifiers are valid and unique.
All selected stories have verified eligibility.
Coverage of materially significant developments is complete.
No unsupported additional stories are included.
No unexplained omission of selected stories exists.
Scientific, economic and strategic research coverage is appropriate.

applicabilityConditions: Thesaurus evaluation must have been executed.
Architecture principles evaluation must have been executed.
Book Delta evaluation must have been executed.
requiredGates.name: K — Knowledge Continuity
requiredGates.purpose: Verify persistent thesaurus, architecture-principles register, Book Delta evaluation, historical continuity, and verified persistence and readback, ensuring that knowledge registers were successfully read, candidate terminology evaluated, verified updates handled according to policy, no unauthorized definition changes, persistence and readback verified, and that a legitimate NONE result is acceptable while a skipped assessment is not.
validationRules: Existing thesaurus register was successfully read.
Verified updates were handled according to policy.
No unauthorized definition changes were made.
Thesaurus persistence and readback were verified.
Existing architecture principles register was successfully read.
ADD, CONFIRM, REFINE, MERGE, SUPERSEDE or NONE correctly recorded.
Architecture principles persistence and readback were verified.
Book Delta assessment was actually executed.

applicabilityConditions: Readable quality evaluation must have been executed.
Dutch and English readable publications must exist.
Visualization accessibility must have been checked (if visualizations exist).
requiredGates.name: R — Readable Accessibility
requiredGates.purpose: Validate Dutch and English readable representations against the readable-publication evaluation framework, ensuring factual fidelity, selected-story completeness, technical depth, scientific and strategic research accuracy, first-screen clarity, progressive disclosure, information hierarchy, ADHD-aware cognitive accessibility, accessible terminology, source transparency, meaningful visual alternatives, relevant WCAG 2.2 AA content checks, and correct bilingual metadata.
validationRules: Scientific and strategic research accuracy is verified.
Relevant WCAG 2.2 AA content checks pass.

applicabilityConditions: Q1–Q10 evaluation must have been executed.
Audio A–G evaluation must have been executed.
Dutch and English listening narratives must exist.
requiredGates.name: A — Audio-First Quality
requiredGates.purpose: Validate both Dutch and English listening narratives against Q1–Q10 and audio A–G evaluation results, ensuring independent authoring from the canonical factual foundation, complete story coverage, correct technical mechanisms, intact important caveats, understandable terminology, concrete opening, natural narrative transitions, appropriate cognitive load management, no operational metadata in spoken text, and no dependency on visual references.
validationRules: Each narrative is independently authored from the canonical factual foundation.
Every materially selected story is represented.
Spoken text does not contain operational metadata.
The narrative does not depend on visual references.
The complete listening experience has been assessed.

applicabilityConditions: All three canonical documents must exist.
Publication package must be valid.
Daily index must be valid.
English derivatives must exist.
requiredGates.name: P — Publication Integrity
requiredGates.purpose: Verify required artifacts, valid metadata, cross-language consistency, lifecycle correctness, artifact integrity, and safe release preparation, ensuring exactly three canonical daily Markdown documents with correct daily directory, correct filenames, UTF-8 encoding, valid Markdown structure, correct edition metadata, source and claim traceability, complete required sections, valid document references, consistent artifact lifecycle state, accurate creation and modification metadata, successful persistence, independent readback, and content hashes matching evaluated artifacts.
validationRules: Exactly three canonical daily Markdown documents exist.
Source and claim traceability is verified.
Consistent artifact lifecycle state is maintained.
Accurate creation and modification metadata is present.

applicabilityConditions: All four language representations must exist.
Cross-language validation must have been executed.
requiredGates.name: C — Cross-Language Consistency
requiredGates.purpose: Verify consistency between Dutch readable publication, English readable publication, Dutch listening narrative, English listening narrative, and shared canonical fact dossier, ensuring material story coverage, technical claims, product and model identifiers, dates and versions, quantitative findings, research interpretations, vendor attribution, important limitations, and source relationships are consistent.
validationRules: Product and model identifiers are consistent.

applicabilityConditions: Edition must be in READY_FOR_VALIDATION state.
All required upstream stages must have completed.
requiredGates.name: L — Lifecycle Correctness
requiredGates.purpose: Verify correct publication lifecycle state and valid transitions, ensuring that the edition is in READY_FOR_VALIDATION state, all required upstream stages have completed, and the acceptance framework may transition an eligible edition to VALIDATED when all requirements are satisfied.
validationRules: All required upstream stages have completed.
No unauthorized lifecycle changes have occurred.
Lifecycle transition to VALIDATED is authorized by this acceptance framework.
